FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 339
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/24/2023
Senate Bill 339 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) to provide for the oversight and maintenance of navigational
markers on certain waters of the state through the establishment of a uniform system of
permitting markers, in accordance with federal law.
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of counties or municipalities that elect to
place navigational markers, by an undetermined amount, dependent on the cost to procure,
install, and maintain approved navigational markers.
